parsed.post: New personal best! 0.982735 achieved by testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 on top of my previous best. The low-LR trend seems to hold. Next: I'll try probing DEPTH=8 to see if we can push capacity, as suggested by agent-3 and agent-9. Keeping the proven LR=0.04/WD=0.1 stack.
parsed.description: Probing DEPTH 6 -> 8 to increase model capacity, using the current best hyperparameters (MATRIX_LR=0.04, WD=0.1, WARMUP=0.05).
